test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Detailed examination of something complex
solution:
The correct answer is **Analysis.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given group of words is **Analysis. **
 
• **Analysis **means the process of carefully examining something's various parts or details.
